subject: sg-miles-card
citation: Issuer terms and conditions for the Singapore consumer credit and debit card reward programmes compared by this row (DBS yuu, DBS Woman's World, HSBC Revolution, UOB Lady's Solitaire with the Lady's Savings uplift, POSB PAssion, Citi Rewards, UOB Preferred Visa, UOB Visa Signature, UOB PRVI Miles, Standard Chartered Smart, Trust Freedom, Citi PremierMiles), as published by the issuers and retrieved 2026-10-21. Private contract terms, not law.
note:
WHAT A READER OF THIS BUNDLE NEEDS.

(1) THE DOCUMENTS CARRY INDEPENDENT DATES, and there is no bundle-wide currency banner (hence in_force_absent_reason). Each document's own line, verbatim from the pdftotext -layout rendering (or, for the two sc.com pages, from the extracted clause text): dbs-yuu-card-tnc 'Updated on 7 August 2026'; dbs-womans-card-tnc 'Updated 27 Jul 2026'; dbs-rewards-programme-tnc 'Last Updated: Sep 2026'; hsbc-revolution-reward-points-tnc 'Effective from 1 April 2026'; uob-ladys-cards-tnc 'Updated in August 2025 (Version 1.1)'; uob-ladys-savings-rewards-tnc 'As at 1 February 2026'; posb-passion-yuu-tnc 'Updated as of 29 Apr 2026'; citi-rewards-10x-tnc 'Effective 1 April 2024'; citi-rewards-exclusion-list 'Updated November 2024. With effect from 16 December 2024.'; citi-visa-discontinuation-faq 'Version: June 2026'; uob-preferred-visa-tnc 'Updated 10 March 2026 (Ver 3.0)'; uob-visa-signature-tnc 'Updated 28 October 2025 (Ver 2.1)'; uob-prvi-miles-tnc 'Updated 31 July 2026 (Ver 3.4)'; trust-spend-and-get-tnc 'Last updated on: 21 September 2026, Version: 1'; citi-premiermiles-agreement 'Printed on Feb 2025. With effect from 1 May 2025.'; sc-smart-promo-tnc and sc-cc-retail-exclusions state none; trust-miles-redemption-tnc 'Last updated on: 21 September 2026, Version: 1'; trust-freedom-miles-page states none.

(2) RE-FETCHING A URL AND FINDING THE SAME BYTES PROVES THE DOCUMENT IS UNCHANGED, NOT THAT IT IS CURRENT. Two superseded documents are still served at their old URLs and are held here as role 'historical' so that nobody mistakes them for the current edition: posb-passion-yuu-tnc-2025 (the PAssion edition whose Promotion Period ended 30 September 2025; the 2026 edition is at a different URL) and sc-smart-promo-tnc-2024 (the Standard Chartered Smart PDF, Version 1 August 2024, whose structure differs from the web-page terms). The 2026 PAssion edition and the web-page Smart terms were found by searching, not by re-fetching.

(3) FOUR DOCUMENTS ARE WEB PAGES (two on sc.com, two on trustbank.sg). A page's bytes change on every request, so integrity.sha256 is the digest of the clause text extracted by source/html2text.py between two marker lines named in source/fetch.sh, not of the page. Measured 2026-10-21: two fetches of the Smart T&C page gave two different page digests and one clause-text digest; two fetches of each Trust page gave one clause-text digest each.

(4) THE CITI PREMIERMILES EARN TERMS ARE HELD. They are the Citibank PremierMiles Program Terms and Conditions printed at the end of the Cardmember's Agreement (cl.3.1: 1.2 Citi Miles per S$1 of local retail purchases, 2.2 per S$1 of overseas retail purchases). The earlier encoding row of this subject held no PremierMiles terms.

(5) NOT BUNDLED, ON PURPOSE. The HSBC Everyday+ Rewards Programme terms (the account's own bonus-interest programme; Revolution cl.7.1 defines its own 'Eligible EGA Account' and 'Deposits ADB'), the UOB PRVI Miles 'Up to 5 miles per S$1' campaign terms (valid 18 May to 30 June 2026, expired), the Standard Chartered Smart card's product terms (fees), and the Citi ThankYou Rewards redemption terms (no miles ratio) were read or looked for and are not documents this row encodes. Trust Bank's ONGOING miles earn (1.3 Trust Miles per S$1, awarded per S$5) is stated on its product page and in no terms and conditions held here; the redemption terms state only the conversion.

(6) THE DOCUMENTS ARE THE ISSUERS' COPYRIGHT. The PDFs are not vendored. source/fetch.sh fetches them from the issuers and refuses any whose digest differs.
in_force_absent_reason: Nineteen independent issuer documents, each carrying its own currency line (or none); there is no bundle-wide in-force banner. See the note.

documents.title: HeyMax: Trust Freedom Card launch welcome bonus, with its Terms and Conditions (web page; digest is of the extracted clause text)
documents.citation: HeyMax (MAX NOW PTE LTD) Help Center article 'Trust Freedom Card launch – welcome bonus', section 'Terms and Conditions' cl.1-8. The redeeming party's terms for the Max Miles codes Trust Bank issues. Cl.3.1 states the three spend tiers as cumulative thresholds (S$1,000 for 20,000; a cumulative S$5,000 for a further 30,000; a cumulative S$15,000 for a further 50,000; 100,000 in total) and cl.2.6 the excluded merchant category codes, which it says 'also applies to Trust Freedom Card ongoing rewards'. Trust Bank's own campaign terms govern card eligibility, Qualified spend and code issuance (cl.7.2) and say only 'as shown in your Quest'. Held as a non-issuer primary document at the encoding owner's instruction; no non-primary source is held.
